about: Every deed the ledger counts (player_state.gd's deeds, deed(), done(); kept in the save). A bar card names one of these to be unlocked (assets/data/bars/). 'counted' says what one count is; 'where' is the marked hook (a line ending '# bars: a deed') or the rule in scripts/deeds.gd that counts it. One event counts once: the same pane, person, place or conversation partner is not counted again where 'counted' says first. The bars worker owns these names; nobody else writes deeds.

families.violence: what he does with a gun
families.law: the police, the court, the jail
families.gunstore: the gun store and its range, and the stash at home
families.music: songs, videos and how they went
families.places: the first time he arrives at each place
families.people: the first conversation with each person
families.everyday: talking, roofs, cellars, sleeping at home
families.angel: the good side's deeds: walking away, going out clean
families.side: the side picked at the start

window_broken.counted: each pane his round breaks that was whole (Glass.hits is 1 after it)

person_shot.counted: each unhurt person his round wounds (their first wound; a second round in the same person is not counted)

person_killed.counted: each person his round puts down

held_up.counted: each time someone puts their hands up to his gun

let_go.counted: each time someone he held up runs off unhurt because he lowered the gun

shot_at_by_gang.counted: each armed man (not police) who opens fire on him: the first round from each shooter on a visit

shot_at_by_police.counted: each officer who opens fire on him: the first round from each on a visit

wounded.counted: each round that hits him while he is still up

hospitalized.counted: each time he is put down and wakes in the hospital (or the jail's treatment room)

jail_night.counted: each night slept out on his bunk at the county jail

searched.counted: each time an officer pats him down (the courthouse search)

court_clean.counted: walking through the courthouse metal detector with nothing on him (green): once a visit

weapon_bought.counted: each weapon bought at the gun store

rounds_bought.counted: each box of rounds bought at the gun store

bullseye.counted: each round in the ten ring of a range target

guns_stashed.counted: each time he leaves his guns in the stash at the crib

song_recorded.counted: each song recorded at the booth microphone

video_shot.counted: each music video shot and premiered

video_flopped.counted: each video that premiered at two stars or fewer

video_went_big.counted: each video that premiered at four stars or more

mishap_handled.counted: each mishap on a shoot he dealt with in time

mishap_missed.counted: each mishap on a shoot he let go wrong

song_written.counted: each song written in the notebook and saved (SAVE THE SONG)

cap_used.counted: each cap card (one he has not earned) in a song recorded at the booth mic

roof.counted: each trip up onto a roof (Large Fry's, the studio's)

cellar.counted: each trip down into the corner store's cellar

slept_home.counted: each night slept in his own bed

walked_away.counted: each time he leaves a place where someone drew on him without firing a round there (not arrested, not put down)

guns_left_home.counted: each time he leaves the crib with nothing on him and his guns in the stash (not arrested, not put down)

chose_angel.counted: a new game begun on the angel's side

chose_devil.counted: a new game begun on the devil's side
